title: In Space

tutorial.title: How to make J Dilla - “In Space” in ABLETON [TUTORIAL]
tutorial.author: Alessio Arca
tutorial.note: The linked video is a 49-second Ableton tutorial demonstrating the beat, not the record itself. YouTube media URLs returned HTTP 403 from this host (datacenter IP; PO token and visitor cookies did not clear the CDN block), so the analysis below measures the full recording instead.

source.note: Full-length fan upload matching the canon identity. Retained locally only; audio is not committed. Rights remain with the rights holders.

analyzer.separation: demucs htdemucs (CPU), four stems: drums, bass, other, vocals
analyzer.measurement: librosa 1.0.1: onset and beat tracking, band-limited onsets, CQT chroma, Krumhansl key correlation, template chord matching, pyin f0

swing.note: The off-8th residual is noisy on this upload because the 150-1200 Hz band also carries keys; treat swing as the canon value (52.7%) rather than the mix-derived mean.

key.note: The chord loop G#m9-C#m9 fixes the tonal centre on G# minor. The canon's C major estimate is a single-method full-mix correlation at low confidence (r=0.51) and does not agree with the stem chroma.

measurements.chord_evidence: Folded over 77 bars, all eight half-bar slots alternate G#m9 and C#m9; the bass stem's strongest pitch class alternates G# and C# in the same two-bar cycle.

melody.note: pyin over the 'other' stem, C3-C6. The contour centres on E and B, chord tones of the G#m9/C#m9 loop. This is a measured contour summary, not a note-for-note lead transcription.

drum_evidence.note: Steps are 16ths from the harmonic bar start (chord changes land on the bar). The sampled break is syncopated and the drum stem carries harmonic bleed, so single-lane grids are approximate and phase-sensitive; the recreation treats these as accents, not a transcription.

canon_comparison.agreement: Tempo and high-band restraint agree with the canon. Key estimate does not: canon says C major (r=0.51); the stems and the chord loop say G# minor / B major.

limits: The tutorial video itself could not be downloaded from this host; the full record was analysed instead.
Stem separation and band-limited onset detection are approximate; no isolated lane is claimed as a transcription.
Chord qualities are template-matched. m9 is the best fit; the record may voice the loop as plain minor triads or add extensions the templates do not resolve.
Swing is reported from the canon because the mix-derived off-8th residual is too noisy on this upload.
No listening acceptance is claimed. The rendered WAV still requires human audition.
